title: Your Journey
newClaim: Once your first deposit arrives, this page will show how your money has moved.
newDipClaim: Prices sometimes fall for a while. Once your money is invested, this section will show how it moved through a dip.

one.rateLine: Shown as a percent, what it earned is called your {rate}.

sinceMarch.summary: From {from} to {to}, your balance went from {start} to {end}.
sinceMarch.layers: Show what you put in and what it earned
sinceMarch.chartTitle1m: Your balance in the last month
sinceMarch.chartTitle3m: Your balance in the last 3 months
sinceMarch.layersOn: The flat layer is what you put in, and the grainy layer above it is what it earned.
sinceMarch.layersOff: The chart shows your balance as one line.

dip.backAbove: {date}: Your balance was back above what you had put in.
dip.summary: Your balance from {from} to {to}, with the dip and what came after.
dip.chartTitle: The dip and what came after
dip.eventsOn: A diamond marks each event, and the list below the chart names them.
dip.eventsOff: The chart shows your balance without the events.
dip.dcaLine: Buying the same amount every month is called {dca}.

tryIt.claim: Practice lets you try a mix with practice money. Nothing you do there touches your account.
tryIt.timeMachine: Its time machine shows how a mix could have moved over the last year.

headStart.intro: You started at {startAge}. If you keep adding {monthly} a month, here's where it could be at {endAge}. Waiting means less time for {compounding}, so catching up costs more.
headStart.introNew: You're {startAge}. If you add {monthly} a month from now, here's where it could be at {endAge}. Waiting means less time for {compounding}, so catching up costs more.
headStart.noCatch: No amount up to ${dollars} a month catches up.
headStart.result: At {endAge}: {keep} if you keep going, {later} if you wait.
headStart.resultNew: At {endAge}: {keep} if you start now, {later} if you wait.
headStart.day: Age {age}: {keep} if you keep going, {later} if you wait.
headStart.dayNew: Age {age}: {keep} if you start now, {later} if you wait.
